Thanks for flagging Neha — I dug into the logs you attached. Quick notes:

- IP 52.23.11.94 matched three distinct signups in a 90-minute window, two of which used variants of the brightchat.io domain (daniel@brightchat.io, billing@brightchat.io).
- Device fingerprint 7f3c2a1b appears in 4 recent signups (internal index). That fingerprint also correlates with two other trial provisions in the last 48h.
- The email domain brightchat.io is not on our disposable list, but the pattern (multiple short-lived accounts with similar metadata) is consistent with bot-driven abuse.

Recommendation:
1) Place the $500 promo on hold immediately (prevent further consumption).
2) Revoke credits if we confirm abuse.
3) Send verification to the user requesting company domain confirmation (company website, LinkedIn, or a billing email) — escalate to sales if they provide convincing info.

I've attached a short summary I pulled (suspicious_domains.pdf). Priyom — can you check whether the IP belongs to a known cloud provider/proxy and whether there's an associated risk score we can surface in HubSpot?

If everyone agrees, Neha can send the verification email below to Daniel. I'll mark the internal alert and add a JIRA ticket.

Hi Daniel — I'm Neha on the Redwood team; congrats and welcome. We provisioned $500 in trial credits for BrightChat earlier, but our automated systems flagged the signup for verification due to multiple signups from the same IP and some unusual account metadata. To be safe we have temporarily placed the promo credits on hold — you should not see further usage charged against them while we verify.

Could you please reply with one of the following so we can re-enable the credits quickly:
- A link to BrightChat's company website and confirmation that daniel@brightchat.io is a company address; or
- A LinkedIn profile that matches your role at BrightChat; or
- If you prefer, reply from a billing address (e.g., billing@brightchat.io) or provide a screenshot of your company admin dashboard showing the BrightChat domain.

If we don't hear back within 72 hours we'll revoke the promotional credits and close the trial. If this is an error on our side, we will restore credits immediately upon confirmation.

Apologies for the extra step — we try to keep trials frictionless but need to prevent abuse to keep credits available for legitimate teams. Feel free to reply here or reach me at neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com / +1 (415) 555-0191.

Best,
